mean_en: a severe and often fatal disease in humans and nonhuman primates (monkeys and chimpanzees) caused by the Ebola virus; characterized by high fever and severe internal bleeding; can be spread from person to person; is largely limited to Africa
sentence: During an Ebola outbreak, avoiding contact with infected individuals and their personal items is crucial for prevention.
sentence_trans: 在埃博拉病毒爆发期间，避免接触感染者及其个人物品对预防至关重要。
